description: This file contains integration test cases for collateral product operations in the Fineract project, including creating and updating collateral products. It uses REST-assured for API testing and JUnit 5 for test execution.

classes.name: CollateralProductIntegrationTest
classes.description: Integration test class for collateral product API endpoints, verifying creation and update operations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured configuration, request and response specifications, and helper utilities before each test.

methods.name: createCollateralProductTest
methods.description: Test case for creating a new collateral product via API and asserting the created ID is not null.

methods.name: updateCollateralProductTest
methods.description: Test case for updating an existing collateral product and verifying the update returns the same resource ID.
